Conversations may start to carry more emotional weight than either person realizes, even when discussing everyday topics. When one person pushes for vulnerability before the other is ready, genuine connection can start to feel like pressure instead of trust-building. At its worst, it can create mental control, obsession, interrogation, or a dynamic where one person feels constantly analyzed.
advice: At its best, this aspect creates honest, transformative dialogue. It can help both people think more clearly, speak more truthfully, and uncover what has been hidden or avoided.
